posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif is reportedly in talks to star in Chandni Bar 2 alongside Tabu, marking her Bollywood comeback after maternity leave following the birth of son Vihaan Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali released on June 12 to universal critical acclaim. Meanwhile, his historic Wembley Stadium concert is set for September 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser clocked 75M+ views in 24 hours as Alia transforms into a fierce assassin for YRF's first female-led spy film, releasing July 3. Film critic Anupama Chopra calls the Cannes 2026 trolling a paid campaign.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka publicly praised Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser, joining SRK, Salman, and other stars in endorsing the YRF spy film. She remains the only Bollywood actor Karan Johar follows on Instagram.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK returns with King in 2026 alongside daughter Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone. He publicly praised Alia's Alpha teaser, and Deepika recently filmed intense action sequences with him at Golden Tobacco Studio.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is gearing up for Meghna Gulzar's thriller Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran. Reports of her joining Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film were debunked — casting won't begin until end of June.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biographical drama Eetha has locked an August 28 release. She plays legendary Marathi folk artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar in what's being called her most challenging role yet.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is filming King with SRK while pregnant with her second child. Director Atlee has arranged body doubles for her action scenes in Allu Arjun's Raaka. She subtly addressed the Sandeep Reddy Vanga rift at a Stockholm event.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar franchise crossed ₹3,100 crore worldwide across both films. Viral claims about Dhurandhar 3 releasing June 14 were debunked as fake — no sequel has been officially announced.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya's absence from the L'Oréal Cannes 2026 posters sparked global outrage despite being a brand ambassador since 2003. Fans questioned why newer ambassadors were featured over her.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika may headline a biopic of legendary Carnatic singer M.S. Subbulakshmi. She has Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor releasing June 19 and recently presented at the Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside The Weeknd.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19 — a Baasha-style action drama she also produced. She performs action sequences in a saree with no body double in what the director calls her most powerful performance yet.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun praised brother Ram Charan's 'mind-blowing' performance in Peddi. His next film Raaka with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone is a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle expected in late 2027.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi has crossed ₹185 crore net in India and $3M in North America within a week. It's Ram Charan's first solo film to hit ₹200 crore gross, though makers are reportedly planning a re-edit to boost the second half.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR confirmed a four-film lineup including Dragon with Prashanth Neel (June 2027) and a reunion with director Trivikram. He was also introduced to a top Marvel Studios executive, sparking MCU crossover buzz.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi faces a firestorm over her character's portrayal in Ram Charan's Peddi, with audiences criticizing the hyper-sexualization and a controversial forced kiss scene. Director Buchi Babu Sana has issued a public apology.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya was among the first celebs to congratulate Deepika and Ranveer on their second pregnancy announcement. She was unfollowed by Karan Johar in his Instagram cleanse along with most of Bollywood.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed baby girl Saraayah, marking the couple's transition into parenthood. She was last seen in War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik won hearts with his gracious response after Varun Dhawan's viral mimicry on The Great Indian Kapil Show. He has a confirmed cameo as Kabir in Alia Bhatt's Alpha, connecting the YRF Spy Universe.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan released June 5. His hilarious Hrithik Roshan mimicry on Kapil Show went viral — Hrithik messaged back saying he loved it.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya's 'The Unstoppable Tour' kicks off September with 12 North American arena dates including Newark, Boston, Oakland, and Toronto. She recently purchased a luxury ₹29.7 crore Worli home in Mumbai.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman scored Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga (released June 12) and is confirmed for Mani Ratnam's next film with Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi, reviving one of cinema's most iconic composer-director duos.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's blockbuster Mersal is set for a 100-screen theatrical re-release on June 19 ahead of his 52nd birthday on June 22. His political film Jananayagan is expected to target a July release window.
